terra.problem: The text says Esther found favor, but does not say the king was glad to see her.
The text does not mention a crown or say where one is.
The cookie-plate joke places the king's offer at a plate of cookies. He makes the offer in the court, before Esther invites him to the banquet.
The king offers up to half the kingdom, not simply half. The text also does not establish that his offer is bigger than any province Esther might choose.
The reference given supports Mordecai urging Esther to go, but not the statement that he is her cousin. That relationship needs its own reference, such as Esther 2:7.
